senses.gloss: (cmp. חבט) to knock down.—Part. pass. חָמֵיט, חֲמִיט prostrated, kneeling, (as verb) to kneel.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 46:1">Targ. Is. XLVI, 1</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 95:6">Targ. Ps. XCV, 6</cite> <he>נַחֲמוֹט</he> (some ed. <he>נַחֲמִיט</he>).

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 28:35">Targ. Y. Deut. XXVIII, 35</cite> <he>חֲמִיטְתּוּן … עבירתא</he> (some ed. <cite ref="H01179"><he>חַמִּי׳</he></cite> incorr.; not <cite ref="P00045"><he>עבידתא</he></cite>); cmp.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 4:4">Targ. Job IV, 4</cite> <he>דחָמְטָן</he>. [<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 4:9">Koh. R. to IV, 9</cite>, end <he>חמטת</he>, some ed., read: <he>דמָטַת</he>.]
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 17:13">Targ. Ps. XVII, 13</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 18:40">Ib. XVIII, 40</cite> Reg. (ed. <cite ref="V00076"><he>תברתא</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Shabbat 54b">Sabb. 54ᵇ</cite> <he>דלא לִיחַמְטָן אליתייהו</he> Ms. M. (ed. incorr.) that their tails may not knock against (the rocks &c., Rashi; Ar.: ‘may not ulcerate’; v. Syr. <he>חמטא</he> pustula, ulcus, P. Sm. 1303; v. <cite ref="H01169">preced.</cite>).
